milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close enough to the rail tracks (centered at spawn-relative 0, -1, 9 where the minecart sits on the rails) and face toward them. max_distance=5 ensures the player has entered the tunnel (nearest rail is at Z=6, about 6 blocks from spawn), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking toward the rails rather than away. This correctly models 'player can see the rail tracks'.
